name: cavemio-feature-tabs
title: Feature tabs
description: One panel, many features: the line slides between tabs, fills as autoplay runs, and the panel eases to each.

cavemio.accessibility:
- A real tablist with a labelled tabpanel; arrow keys, Home and End move between tabs and only the chosen tab is in the tab order.
- Autoplay pauses while the pointer or focus is anywhere inside, so it never moves under someone reading.
- The progress is a CSS animation, so nothing re-renders while it runs.
- With reduced motion there is no autoplay and content changes in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: tabs
props.description: – · Each tab and what its panel shows.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.description: – · The chosen tab, controlled or not.

props.name: autoplay
props.description: – · Move on every this many ms, with the line as the timer. Off with reduced motion.

useCases.title: Feature sections
useCases.description: One tab per feature, each with a screenshot, a video or a small live demo.

useCases.title: Product tours
useCases.description: Autoplay through the product in the order you want it seen.

useCases.title: Solutions pages
useCases.description: One tab per team, role or use case.

useCases.title: Docs landing pages
useCases.description: Switch between platforms or languages on a quick-start page.

features.title: A line that follows the tab
features.description: The line under the chosen tab slides across with a little give, and the label colour follows.

features.title: Autoplay with a visible timer
features.description: The line fills like a progress bar, then hands over to the next tab when it is full.

features.title: It pauses when you do
features.description: Pointing at it, or focus inside, pauses autoplay. Clicking a tab restarts the timer.

features.title: The panel eases to each tab
features.description: The height eases to the new content, which slides in from the side you went.

features.title: Any content in a panel
features.description: A screenshot, a video, a small mock or anything else React can render.

features.title: Real tabs
features.description: A proper tablist with arrow keys, Home and End. With reduced motion there is no autoplay.

states.title: switch
states.description: The line slides and resizes to the tab (520ms, slight overshoot); the label colour follows.

states.title: panel
states.description: Height eases over 460ms; old content slides and blurs out one way, new content in from the other.

states.title: autoplay
states.description: The line fills over the interval and moves to the next tab when full. Pointer or focus inside pauses it; clicking a tab restarts it.
